content.text: Replace this text and the input_json data with actual validated evidence for this question batch.

questions.name: V01
questions.instructions: How effectively does the first 3 seconds create an immediate relevant reason to keep watching? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: No discernible hook in opening.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Opening begins without clear reason to watch.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Topic or problem becomes recognizable, but weak urgency or relevance.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Product problem/result/curiosity is clear quickly.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Immediate, specific, compelling hook directly tied to a viewer need.

questions.name: V02
questions.instructions: How specific and credible is the hook promise to the target audience? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: No identifiable promise.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Generic or vague promise.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Understandable but weakly differentiated.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Specific audience problem or benefit supported by content.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Specific, credible, distinct promise with direct supporting evidence.

questions.name: V03
questions.instructions: How clearly does the video progress from setup to payoff? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: No intelligible structure.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Disjointed narrative, difficult to follow.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Basic sequence but incomplete payoff.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Coherent setup-demo-result progression.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Coherent and engaging progression with convincing payoff.

questions.name: V04
questions.instructions: Does observable visual pacing support comprehension and attention? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: Visual sequence unreadable or essentially unusable.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Extended irrelevant shots or abrupt cuts obscure content.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Mostly understandable but obvious dead space or dense edits.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Shot changes appropriately support main message.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Purposeful pace, visual variation, readable overlays, smooth progression.

questions.name: V05
questions.instructions: Does video establish and resolve a meaningful curiosity gap? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: No curiosity or payoff.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Tease unrelated to product or never resolved.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Some anticipation with partial resolution.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Clear tension/question followed by relevant reveal.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Strong curiosity mechanism and satisfying, verifiable payoff.

questions.name: V06
questions.instructions: How well does the emotional framing fit the target buyer and product context? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: No emotional framing.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Emotion feels irrelevant or manipulative.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Some relatable scenario but generic.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Relatable emotion strengthens core use case.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Distinctive authentic emotional moment closely supports product value.

questions.name: V07
questions.instructions: How much explicit save/share value is present in the content itself? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: No identifiable utility or sharing value.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Little informational, entertainment or social value.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Some useful tip or relatable moment.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Specific advice, demonstration, humor or comparison worth sharing.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: High standalone utility or memorable, grounded insight worth revisiting.

questions.name: V08
questions.instructions: How understandable is the product/topic from the opening visuals or text? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: No relevant opening visual/text.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Opening confusing or unrelated.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Recognizable topic but requires substantial context.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Clear opening composition/text with identifiable context.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Instantly legible topic and value proposition on mobile.

questions.name: C01
questions.instructions: Can a buyer identify the exact product and intended use from the video? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: Product and use impossible to identify.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Product mentioned but type/use unclear.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Recognizable product type, incomplete use/variant.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Specific product and use are clear.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Product, use, key variant and buyer suitability are unambiguous.

questions.name: C02
questions.instructions: How explicitly is the product tied to a concrete buyer problem? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: No buyer problem/use presented.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Unrelated or generic claims.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Some relevance but unclear causal link.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Specific problem and plausible usage benefit shown.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Specific pain point, mechanism and realistic outcome linked by evidence.

questions.name: C03
questions.instructions: How clearly does the video demonstrate actual product usage? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: No usable demonstration.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Product flashed or demonstration illegible.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Use shown briefly without clear outcome.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Usage steps and observed outcome understandable.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Detailed, easy-to-follow real use with verifiable visible outcome.

questions.name: C04
questions.instructions: How specific and substantiated are the product benefits presented? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: No relevant benefit.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Generic claim with no specifics.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Benefit expressed but weak evidence or detail.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Concrete benefit linked to visible usage/attributes.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Specific, buyer-relevant benefit supported by clear evidence and limitations.

questions.name: C06
questions.instructions: How credible is the evidence supporting persuasion, avoiding unsupported claims? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: Materially misleading or unsupported proof presented as certain.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Main claims unsupported, manipulated or unverifiable.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Mixed claims and observable proof with important gaps.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Mostly verifiable demonstrations and appropriately qualified claims.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Transparent, specific and consistently checkable evidence, no material contradiction.

questions.name: C07
questions.instructions: How clearly and accurately does the video communicate any purchase offer? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: Offer absent or impossible to identify.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Vague incentive with critical conditions missing.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Offer identifiable but key price/terms missing.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Price, promotion and basic conditions understandable.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Clear, accurate offer with meaningful terms and eligibility communicated.
